lines.zh: 我贴着沙底滑，几乎不抬身
lines.en: I glide along the sand, barely lifting my body.

lines.zh: 我的肚子蹭着泥，留下一道浅痕
lines.en: My belly scrapes the mud, leaving a thin trail.

lines.zh: 两条同类并排，像两块石头挪动
lines.en: Two of us side by side, like stones shifting.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，沙比我快一点
lines.en: I move slowly; the sand moves a little faster.

lines.zh: 我一半身子埋着，一半在游
lines.en: Half of me is buried; half of me swims.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我顺着它偏过去
lines.en: The current pushes; I lean with it.

lines.zh: 我不用鳍走路，我用整个平面
lines.en: I do not walk on fins; I walk on my flatness.

lines.zh: 上面有影子掠过，我压低一点
lines.en: A shadow passes over; I press down lower.

lines.zh: 海草在左边，我绕开它的根
lines.en: Kelp on the left; I skirt around its roots.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，沙会自己合上
lines.en: Where I pass, the sand closes over itself.

lines.zh: 两只眼睛朝上，路在下面
lines.en: Both eyes face up; the road is below.

lines.zh: 我挪到更暗的沙上，那里更好藏
lines.en: I shift to darker sand; it hides me better.

lines.zh: 这条沟我走过，泥还记得我的形状
lines.en: I know this trench; the mud remembers my shape.

lines.zh: 我慢慢横过海底，像一块活的石头
lines.en: I cross the floor slowly, a living stone.

lines.zh: 我抖一下边鳍，往前挪半格
lines.en: One flick of my fin edge moves me half a block.

lines.zh: 泥里有只蟹，我绕开它
lines.en: There is a crab in the mud; I go around it.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼看看上面，再落下
lines.en: I lift an eye to look up, then settle again.

lines.zh: 沙底的沟沿，我顺着走
lines.en: I follow the ridge of a groove in the sand.

lines.zh: 我躺在泥里，装成一块泥
lines.en: I lie in the mud, pretending to be mud.

lines.zh: 沙落在我背上，我不抖
lines.en: Sand gathers on my back and I let it stay.

lines.zh: 我屏住呼吸，等掠食者走远
lines.en: I hold my breath until the hunter moves on.

lines.zh: 水很暖，我不打算动
lines.en: The water is warm; I plan to stay still.

lines.zh: 我的两只眼各看一边，很省力
lines.en: My two eyes look apart; it saves effort.

lines.zh: 上面有鱼群经过，我数了数
lines.en: A school passes above; I count them.

lines.zh: 泥沙的味道有点咸，也有点凉
lines.en: The silt tastes salty, and a little cold.

lines.zh: 我把鳍收平，让自己更像海床
lines.en: I flatten my fins to look more like the floor.

lines.zh: 海面很远，我懒得上去
lines.en: The surface is far; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 有只蟹爬过我背，我没意见
lines.en: A crab crawls over me; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 静下来，能听见沙粒互相碰
lines.en: In the quiet, I hear grains of sand touch.

lines.zh: 我睡了半只眼，另半只留着
lines.en: I sleep with half an eye, keeping the other.

lines.zh: 秋天水凉，我埋得比夏天深
lines.en: Autumn water cools; I bury deeper than in summer.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，这本身就是本事
lines.en: Doing nothing is itself a skill of mine.

lines.zh: 我从沙里抬起两只眼，看你
lines.en: I lift both eyes from the sand to see you.

lines.zh: 你站在船上，船影落在我背上
lines.en: You stand in a boat; its shadow falls on me.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩进浅水，泥都翻起来了
lines.en: Your feet stir the shallows and the mud.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，你才看见沙在动
lines.en: I watched you long before the sand moved.

lines.zh: 你的网在水里，我看得清清楚楚
lines.en: Your net is in the water; I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 我贴得更平了，希望你没发现
lines.en: I flatten further, hoping you miss me.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我的一只眼对上了你
lines.en: You crouch; one of my eyes meets yours.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道比海水重
lines.en: You smell heavier than the sea does.

lines.zh: 别踩这里，我就在你脚边的沙下
lines.en: Not here; I am in the sand by your feet.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，谁也没先动
lines.en: We look at each other; neither moves first.

lines.zh: 我被翻了过来，肚皮朝天
lines.en: I am flipped over, belly to the sky.

lines.zh: 沙被搅开，我的藏身处没了
lines.en: The sand is torn open; my hiding place is gone.

lines.zh: 血混进泥里，颜色变深了
lines.en: Blood mixes into the mud and darkens it.

lines.zh: 我拼命往沙里钻，钻不进去
lines.en: I dig frantically at sand that will not take me.

lines.zh: 三点生命，很薄，像我的身子
lines.en: Three hearts, thin as my body is thin.

lines.zh: 你伤了我，我只好换个海底
lines.en: You hurt me; I must find another floor.

lines.zh: 我疼得把两只眼都缩进去
lines.en: The pain pulls both my eyes inward.

lines.zh: 这一下让我贴得更紧了
lines.en: That blow made me press down harder.

lines.zh: 我游不快，逃起来格外难看
lines.en: I swim slowly; my escape is ugly.

lines.zh: 别再来一下，我的骨头很细
lines.en: Not another hit; my bones are very fine.

lines.zh: 那条虫沉下来，正好落在我的沙上
lines.en: The worm sinks and lands right on my sand.

lines.zh: 我明知钩子在旁边，还是张了嘴
lines.en: The hook is right there; I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 秋天我吃得最多，现在正好
lines.en: In autumn I eat most; the season suits me.

lines.zh: 饵的味道钻进泥里，藏不住
lines.en: The bait's smell seeps into mud; it cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，怕惊动了它
lines.en: I creep over, afraid of startling it.

lines.zh: 一条虫够我饱一天，值这个险
lines.en: One worm feeds me a day; worth the risk.

lines.zh: 我试了一口，钩尖擦过我的嘴角
lines.en: I try a bite; the hook grazes my mouth.

lines.zh: 饥饿比警惕更靠近我
lines.en: Hunger comes closer to me than caution.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃竿，我的眼跟着晃
lines.en: You wiggle the rod; my eyes wiggle along.

lines.zh: 沙下的我很饿，沙上的我很怕
lines.en: Hungry under the sand, frightened above it.

lines.zh: 你踢到的是我的背，不是石头
lines.en: What you kicked was my back, not a stone.

lines.zh: 我只有两成高，你几乎踩平我
lines.en: I am barely a fifth tall; you nearly flatten me.

lines.zh: 我贴在你靴底，滑走了
lines.en: I pressed under your sole and slid free.

lines.zh: 被踩一下，沙替我挡了半力
lines.en: The sand took half the force of that step.

lines.zh: 我扁平的身子一撞就贴回去
lines.en: My flat body bumps, then clings back down.

lines.zh: 你碰到我时，我以为是石头压下来
lines.en: When you touched me, I thought stone fell.

lines.zh: 我抖落背上的沙，露出两只眼
lines.en: I shake off the sand and show both eyes.

lines.zh: 别用脚探路，海底住着东西
lines.en: Do not feel your way with feet; the floor is lived in.

lines.zh: 我滑开半格，又埋回泥里
lines.en: I slip half a block away and bury again.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，不如一次潮水
lines.en: That bump was weaker than one tide.

lines.zh: 两条扁鱼叠在一起，像一块石头
lines.en: Two flat fish stack up like a single stone.

lines.zh: 它把沙拨开，我躺在它旁边
lines.en: It brushes the sand aside; I lie beside it.

lines.zh: 我们不追不闹，只是并排埋着
lines.en: No chasing, no fuss; we bury side by side.

lines.zh: 它的斑纹比我深，我喜欢
lines.en: Its spots are darker than mine; I like that.

lines.zh: 秋天是配对的时候，水也变清了
lines.en: Autumn is for pairing; the water clears too.

lines.zh: 三条鱼里，它先游到我这里
lines.en: Of the three of us, it came to me first.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一点水流，算是答应
lines.en: We trade a little current; that is our yes.

lines.zh: 它把一只眼转过来，我懂了
lines.en: It turns one eye toward me; I understand.

lines.zh: 明年这片沙上会有更多扁影子
lines.en: Next year this sand will hold more flat shadows.

lines.zh: 我们一起沉到泥里，慢慢等
lines.en: We sink into the mud together and wait.

lines.zh: 我是扁的，什么东西都驮不住
lines.en: I am flat; nothing stays carried on my back.

lines.zh: 那块石头落在我身上，我没动
lines.en: The stone landed on me; I did not move.

lines.zh: 我用嘴拱了拱，它滚开了
lines.en: I nosed it once; it rolled away.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西大多沉，我抬不动
lines.en: Fallen things mostly sink, and I cannot lift them.

lines.zh: 有片海草挂在我背上，我留着
lines.en: A bit of kelp caught on me; I keep it.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沉下来，吓走了半群鱼
lines.en: Your boot sank and scattered half the school.

lines.zh: 沙会盖住一切，包括你的东西
lines.en: Sand covers everything, your things included.

lines.zh: 我试过含住一枚贝壳，太重了
lines.en: I tried holding a shell; too heavy for me.

lines.zh: 这里的东西掉下来，就归海床
lines.en: Whatever falls here belongs to the seabed.

lines.zh: 我推不动，只好躺在它旁边
lines.en: I cannot push it, so I lie beside it.

lines.zh: 我盯住钩下的那点影子
lines.en: I fix on the small shadow under the hook.

lines.zh: 泥一动，我就知道虫在哪
lines.en: The mud stirs; I know where the worm is.

lines.zh: 水面破了个洞，我抬头看
lines.en: A hole opens in the surface; I look up.

lines.zh: 我认准了那只脚，它踩得太近
lines.en: I settle on that foot; it steps too near.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼进了我的范围
lines.en: A small fish entered my reach.

lines.zh: 我先看它的鳍，再看它的方向
lines.en: I read its fins, then its direction.

lines.zh: 沙上有一串新脚印，我记住了
lines.en: New prints on the sand; I remember them.

lines.zh: 我不急，目标不会自己游走
lines.en: No hurry; my target will not swim off.

lines.zh: 我的两只眼分开，一只盯它一只盯你
lines.en: One eye tracks it, the other tracks you.

lines.zh: 声音从上面来，我把眼转过去
lines.en: The sound comes from above; my eyes turn.

lines.zh: 我跟着那道影子，在沙上滑
lines.en: I follow that shadow, sliding over sand.

lines.zh: 它走一步，我挪半格
lines.en: It moves a step; I shift half a block.

lines.zh: 我一直藏在它看不见的泥色里
lines.en: I stay in the mud-color it cannot see.

lines.zh: 跟得久了，连水流都认得我
lines.en: Following this long, even the current knows me.

lines.zh: 我不追快的东西，只追慢的
lines.en: I do not chase fast things, only slow ones.

lines.zh: 它停，我停；它动，我先动
lines.en: It stops, I stop; it moves, I move first.

lines.zh: 我把自己调成海底的颜色
lines.en: I tune myself to the color of the floor.

lines.zh: 距离刚好，再近就会惊动它
lines.en: The distance is right; closer and it bolts.

lines.zh: 我盯着那根线，线比鱼诚实
lines.en: I watch the line; it is more honest than the fish.

lines.zh: 影子斜了，说明上头有人转身
lines.en: The shadow tilts; someone above has turned.

lines.zh: 我拍了一下尾巴，把沙扬起来
lines.en: I slap my tail and throw up a cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的脚趾，然后装死
lines.en: I bite your toe, then play dead.

lines.zh: 扁身子一撞，力道散得很开
lines.en: My flat body hits and the force spreads thin.

lines.zh: 我的攻击更像一次推搡
lines.en: My attack is more of a shove.

lines.zh: 沙迷了你的眼，这就够了
lines.en: Sand in your eyes; that is enough.

lines.zh: 我弹出泥面，撞向你的小腿
lines.en: I burst from the mud into your shin.

lines.zh: 这一口只有牙齿的诚意
lines.en: This bite has only the honesty of teeth.

lines.zh: 我打不赢，但我能让你找不到我
lines.en: I cannot win, but I can make myself unfindable.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，正好踩进我藏身处
lines.en: You step back, right into where I hide.

lines.zh: 我撞完就沉底，不留影子
lines.en: I strike, then sink and leave no shadow.

lines.zh: 我在一片泥沙上摊开，慢慢醒来
lines.en: I spread out on silt and slowly wake.

lines.zh: 两条同类落在旁边，各自埋好
lines.en: Two kin land nearby and bury themselves.

lines.zh: 海面在很高处，光落成一片碎银
lines.en: The surface is high; light falls in bits of silver.

lines.zh: 我第一次贴住海床，就不想动了
lines.en: Once I touched the seabed, I stopped wanting to move.

lines.zh: 秋天的水把我送到这片沙
lines.en: Autumn water carried me to this sand.

lines.zh: 出生时我就是扁的，这很方便
lines.en: I was born flat; it is very convenient.

lines.zh: 我钻进泥里，只留两只眼在外
lines.en: I burrow in, leaving only two eyes out.

lines.zh: 上面有鱼游过，我决定先躲
lines.en: Fish pass above; I decide to hide first.

lines.zh: 这片海底空着，正好给我躺
lines.en: This stretch of floor is empty; good for lying.

lines.zh: 我落地时没声音，海床接住了我
lines.en: I landed silently; the seabed caught me.

lines.zh: 火焰先把我烤熟，再让我死
lines.en: The flame cooks me through before I die.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔到海床，砸出一个坑
lines.en: I fall from the surface and dent the seabed.

lines.zh: 鱼在水里淹死，说来也不好笑
lines.en: A fish drowning is not a funny thing.

lines.zh: 爆炸把整片沙底掀了起来
lines.en: The blast lifts the whole sandy floor.

lines.zh: 箭穿过水，扎进我扁扁的身子
lines.en: An arrow cuts the water into my flat body.

lines.zh: 魔法在水里烧，我的鳞全竖起来
lines.en: Magic burns underwater; every scale of mine lifts.

lines.zh: 饿到极处，我连沙都想咬
lines.en: Starving, I would bite even the sand.

lines.zh: 雷打在海面上，白光穿过整层水
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface; white light pierces down.

lines.zh: 虚空之下没有沙，我无处可贴
lines.en: No sand under the void; nowhere to press myself.
